author.name: Edward White
author.title: Co-founder at Rancher
author.proposed_bio: Edward White is co-founder at Rancher. He writes about business-data licensing for AI, with a focus on helping companies understand what they can share, how to prepare their data, and the decisions that come before a licensing agreement.
